''See also: [[Elysian Incarnation Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Elysian]] [[Incarnation]] is the manifestation of the [[Territory]] of [[Elysia]], a role held by [[Alin]], the son of [[Torin]]. Originally born as a [[Traveler]] from one of the most potent Territories, [[Alin]]'s status as an [[Incarnation]] grants him a profound connection to his realm's essence and enhanced mental clarity. While the [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]] were historically regarded as virtuous leaders who supervised other Territories, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] is described by [[Grandmaster Naraka]] as a figure of pure morality lacking in conscience, empathy, or self-control. In practice, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] has established significant [[Authority|authority]] over the city of [[Enosh]], reorganizing it into nine districts modeled after the [[City of Light]]. He has suppressed local resistance and assembled a diverse military force composed of [[Travelers]] from numerous other Territories, including [[Naraka]], [[Tartarus]], and [[Avernus]]. Although [[Alin]] perceives himself as a personification of positive virtues such as wisdom, loyalty, and compassion, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]]'s presence is associated with a shift in power away from the previous oversight of the [[Elysian Traveler|Elysian Travelers]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Elysian]] [[Incarnation]] is an adversary to [[Simon]], whom the entity faces as it seeks to gain control. This force also killed [[Grandmaster Helgard]] and was responsible for the death of [[Queen]] [[Cynara]] during combat.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Elysian]] [[Incarnation]] is an invading force in [[Enosh]], famously linked to legends of [[Queen]] [[Cynara]] giving her life to fight it. During its campaign, the entity executed [[Grandmaster Helgard]] and led a direct attack against the young nation of [[Damasca]]. [[Incarnation|The Incarnation]] also manipulated other [[Incarnations]], prompting [[Simon]] to attempt to prevent it from seizing excessive control. Ultimately, [[Simon]] faces the entity as a person, though he remains uncertain of its true capabilities.}}
